verdict.rationale: CIPO publishes downloadable bulk data, searchable databases and online filing services, so versioned APIs are a fair question for it. However, the evidence never mentions a versioned API or a documented deprecation policy. Bulk data downloads and filing-system release notes are adjacent features, not versioned APIs with a deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
